title: Just found this
content: I found this off of TikTok and omg! I have the craziest dreams and I often return to the same places. One recurring locations is a large water park house mansion. I’m always driving there and I have to take a u-turn to access the road. Once I’m on the road I can either go one way which leads to an almost artificially bright lakeside water park with a huge mansion. I’m always running around the mansion and it was actually the first place where I was able to Lucid dream. If I go the other way I go to an artificially dark house that has one large room. There stained glass on the walls and the room feels empty but also full of people at the same time. I often find myself getting “lost” in that room and feeling so alone … until I’m not. Neither of the locations is scary and they both feel safe. Another recurring place is an “aquatic city” it’s entirely underwater and I get there through a kind of floating subway. There’s a lot of wealth here and I dress very elegantly. I am often attending a dinner in a beautiful restaurant with huge chandeliers. I haven’t been able to lucid dream here but I go there a lot and, for a while, had a steady relationship there. My last location is a true mall. I’ve been there multiple times. The first time I went I was able to lucid dream but once I realized I was lucid I starting taking things and after a few minutes, alarms starting blaring and I had to run up the stairs and out a door that allowed me to wake up. The next few times I went there I was always driven in by a woman. She’s around a lot, sometimes in the passenger seat and sometimes driving - when I go to the mall with her it feels safe and calm and gooey (?) - the same feeling you get when eating a warm pretzel (best description I have). Sometimes I have a job at the mall sometimes I’m waiting for her. Anyone have anything similar?
